decisions.reason: Having survived the first review and fitting routine cross-selling into the installed base, the cleaning soap likely meets low aspiration levels and is inexpensive for the firm to carry.
The care line faces some added scrutiny after Product B was withdrawn, but as the remaining specialist product for oiled floors it still likely stays unless results fall clearly below aspiration.
The moisture-protection underlay supports installation quality and complaint avoidance, so another year of experience likely leaves it at or above the firm's aspiration for accessories.

Because the high-density underlay foam is more commoditised and overlaps with other underlays, accumulated evidence may now place it below aspiration and justify shifting resources to stronger core offers or new development.
The oak parquet line is closest to the firm's core capabilities, brand, and growth path, so boundedly rational management would usually retain it unless an unexpected shortfall emerges.
